name: Rajesh Kumar
key_concern: Rent stability and access to housing subsidies.
citizen_voice: Rent control is vital for families like mine. We can barely afford our current rent, any increase would force us onto the streets. I hope the subsidies are easy to access.

name: Priya Sharma
key_concern: Affordable housing and protection against arbitrary rent hikes.
citizen_voice: Every month is a struggle to pay rent. With unstable work, I need to know my home is secure. Rent control would bring peace of mind.

name: Amit Singh
key_concern: Ensuring basic living standards and accessible housing for the elderly.
citizen_voice: At my age, finding affordable housing is nearly impossible. This policy must truly help those of us with meager savings and high needs.

name: Sunita Devi
key_concern: Support for small businesses and affordable commercial rent.
citizen_voice: My tea stall is my only income. I worry about my home rent, but also my shop's rent. Will 'mixed-use development' mean I can't afford my spot anymore?

name: Gopal Das
key_concern: Prevention of eviction and access to emergency housing aid.
citizen_voice: We live day-to-day. The fear of being evicted because of a missed payment is constant. I hope the new act makes housing truly stable for the poorest.

name: Meena Kumari
key_concern: Guaranteed housing and fair treatment for informal workers.
citizen_voice: I sell vegetables to make ends meet. My biggest worry is where my family will sleep tomorrow. Rent control and subsidies are a lifeline, not just a policy.

name: Vikram Yadav
key_concern: Balancing stable rent with opportunities for homeownership.
citizen_voice: While rent control is good, I also hope for a path to owning a home one day. This policy needs to help us improve our lives, not just stay afloat.

name: Sarita Singh
key_concern: Access to affordable and hygienic living conditions in densely populated areas.
citizen_voice: Our homes are small and overcrowded. Rent control helps, but we also need better sanitation and more space. The policy should address overall quality of life.

name: Javed Khan
key_concern: Equitable application of rent control and subsidy access for cantonment residents.
citizen_voice: Even working for the cantonment, my salary is low. I hope the rent control applies fairly to all residential areas, including ours, and subsidies are not just for others.

name: Ritu Verma
key_concern: Balancing rent control with property owner rights and maintaining investment incentives.
citizen_voice: I rent out a small property for extra income. While I support affordable housing, rent control must also consider the small landlords who rely on this income for their own stability.

name: Bharat Gupta
key_concern: Support for local entrepreneurs and clear guidelines for mixed-use zones.
citizen_voice: I've built my business here. Rent control could help my family's budget, but I'm keen to see how mixed-use development helps local entrepreneurs like me thrive, without pricing us out.

name: Shanti Devi
key_concern: Rent stability and access to good community services.
citizen_voice: As a working mother, stable rent means I can budget for my children's education and health. I hope the policy also brings better parks and schools to our area.

name: Arjun Malhotra
key_concern: Impact of rent control on property values and investment potential.
citizen_voice: I own my home and have invested in a small rental property. Rent control might help tenants, but it could hurt property owners and future development if not balanced correctly.

name: Disha Jain
key_concern: Promoting upscale local businesses and maintaining aesthetic standards in mixed-use areas.
citizen_voice: I support initiatives for local businesses, but any mixed-use development must be aesthetically pleasing and attract quality customers. We need to preserve the character of our area.

name: Mohammed Ali
key_concern: Protecting historical character and supporting traditional businesses amidst new development.
citizen_voice: Our shop has been here for generations. While new development can bring opportunities, it must not erode the unique cultural and commercial identity of Jama Masjid. Support our heritage businesses!

name: Pooja Das
key_concern: Opportunities for artisans in new mixed-use spaces and fair rent for workshops.
citizen_voice: I make traditional crafts. Rent control for my home is welcome, but I hope the mixed-use development includes affordable spaces for artisans to work and sell their goods, keeping our crafts alive.

name: Colonel R. K. Singh (Retd.)
key_concern: Maintaining property values and ensuring stability for retired personnel.
citizen_voice: While housing affordability is important, the value of our homes, accumulated over years of service, must be protected. Rent control shouldn't devalue property in our cantonment areas.

name: Karan Kapoor
key_concern: Investment climate and balanced urban development.
citizen_voice: I look for a balance. Rent control can help, but we need policies that also encourage new housing supply and responsible development to keep our city thriving and attractive for investment.

name: Dr. Anjali Mehta
key_concern: Quality of life, infrastructure, and impact of development on residential zones.
citizen_voice: Vasant Vihar is a prime residential area. While mixed-use development can be good, it must be planned carefully to maintain our green spaces and quality infrastructure. We don't want haphazard growth.

name: Sanjay Kapoor
key_concern: Ensuring inclusive development and preserving community essence.
citizen_voice: I teach here. It's crucial that any new development benefits everyone, not just a few. We need policies that ensure local businesses, schools, and residents all thrive together without losing our community spirit.
